VBO:0201009.summary: Curious, cheerful and sociable, the Petit Basset Griffon Vendéen likes company while keeping a mind of its own. It can enjoy learning and attention, yet an enticing scent may redirect its plans. Developed for small-game hunting in the rough Vendée countryside, this bold hound is especially associated with rabbits and bramble cover, and freely uses its voice.
VBO:0201009.shortDescription: A cheerful, curious French hound with a social nature, an independent streak and strong scent-driven rabbit-hunting roots.

sources.title: FCI Standard67 — Petit Basset Griffon Vendéen
sources.evidence: Actual whole seven-page English FCI67 read, substantive pp2–6. Passionate courageous bramble/scrub hunter, rabbit specialist, docile but wilful; separate Petit standard developed beyond simple Grand height reduction. Whole own head, low inward-rolled ears, dark unobscured eyes, long strong neck, level slightly elongated compact frame, strong proportional bone/feet, high-set complete tapering short sabre tail, harsh not woolly coat and34–38cm size/faults read. FCI rejects crooked/half-crooked forelegs; selected straight legs meet both standards.
